entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the husband of the petitioner no.1 was own younger brother of the O.P. No.2.
It is next submitted that the dispute is purely civil to which a criminal colour has been given.

It is also submitted that petitioner no.1, who is widow of the younger brother of the O.P. No.2 had sold her share of land to the petitioner no.2, who is purchaser but the O.P. No.2 instituted the present false case for coercing the petitioner no.1 into submission taking advantage of her vulnerability as she is a widow.

(Satyavrat Verma, J) amit/-
